## Objetivo
Own authenticated server SSE transport and after-commit publication for existing membership, collection, poll and confirmation mutations. Supply reusable real-stream and publication-order helpers for T14. T15 owns React refetch lifecycle and browser coverage; no client or browser delivery belongs here.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Parameterized real HTTP/SSE tests use two authenticated sessions and cover game create/update/delete, later member registration, poll creation, vote insertion/replacement, confirmation and reconfirmation. Each committed operation delivers invalidation to the second session; subsequent HTTP reads assert canonical changed values, deletions or snapshots. Broad invalidation is acceptable. No credentials or secrets appear in events. Readiness handshakes and bounded stream reads replace arbitrary sleeps. Login/logout are not shared-domain mutations.
- [ ] Publication-order tests instrument the publisher and use an independent SQLite connection to verify committed rows are visible at publication. Validation failures and injected failures after writes but before commit leave data unchanged and invoke the publisher zero times, asserted after request completion. Real-stream tests use the same publisher path. No network wait occurs inside a write transaction. Export reusable helpers under tests/api/ for T14; all databases use injected isolated paths.
- [ ] Extend T08's authorization matrix for SSE: signed-out streams are rejected; disconnect removes subscriptions and timers; logout and expiry revoke existing stream access. Heartbeats are distinguishable from invalidations and bounded tests terminate without hanging handles. Server reconnect requests require current authorization. Client reconnect/refetch behavior is deferred to T15. npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build pass without client or browser changes.
